result.summary: Several layout and content bugs: a raw localization key is shown as a heading, restaurant names and category chips are clipped, and the last popular card is cut off at the bottom.

issues.description: The section heading displays the untranslated localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the localized string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and add a fallback so missing translations never render the raw key.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is clipped on the right so the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated and the card is only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal carousel enough end padding or allow full-width scrolling so the last card (and its full name) is fully visible.

issues.description: The last popular restaurant card is cut off by the bottom tab bar, hiding most of the image and all of the restaurant details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll content so cards can scroll fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off on the right (partial 'Healthy' chip and a sliver of the next chip).
issues.suggestion: Allow the chip row to scroll fully or add trailing inset so the last chips are not clipped.
